facts.fact: Gauri turned back Dhanu's coat at dawn after Raghu's men left the fold at moonset; she found that his shirt was cut at the side and concluded he was dead before the ransom note was written.
facts.why: needed because the beat ends on her line 'He was dead before they wrote it' and the next chapter explains it.

facts.fact: Kunal unties his end of the rope with his teeth before walking toward the Drum; the bond still holds by distance.
facts.why: needed to stage his walk past the rope's eight spans without dragging Ila.
